## SMC
- **2026-08-07 (L1):** Post-blowoff reversal sells are not "ugly structure" — both code-3 skips of SweepMSS SELLs that fired 1–3 bars after a violent top (2021-02-26, 2021-06-02 12:00) ran +3R, while the SweepMSS SELL approved _into_ the still-rising range top (02-24, 87th percentile of the 20-day range, D1 +0.7 ATR above a rising EMA20) lost −1R. After a blowoff + reversal bar, chaos at the top is the setup working — grade it on displacement and the swept pool, not tidiness. Falsified if two such post-reversal sells fail.

## Deep Fib
- **2026-08-08 (L1-alt):** A "counter-trend" (code 1) tag on a chart showing **5+ consecutive D1 closes beyond a sloping EMA20** is a mis-tag — that is an established trend to rejoin, which is DeepFib's whole design. The 2023-03-27 BUY was skipped twice as counter-trend with _eight_ consecutive closes above a rising EMA20 (+57p/5d slope); baseline made +8.45R — the costliest single decision of Level 1. Mirror case: the 02-20 SELL skipped as "ugly" sat 14 closes below a falling EMA20 and made +3.33R. Count the closes before writing code 1. Falsified if two with-trend DeepFibs taken after 5+ consecutive closes both lose.
